about_the_game:
Earth is collapsing. Resources are nearly gone, and the only hope lies beyond mysterious portals leading to undiscovered worlds. LootRun is a first-person exploration and survival game playable solo or online co-op for 2–4 players, where every mission sends you into unpredictable alien environments to gather what humanity needs to survive.

Begin each expedition at a secure Earth base equipped with tools, mission data, and portal access. Some portals reveal limited planetary information before you enter, others remain a complete mystery until you step through. Each session transports you to a vast, living world filled with strange landscapes, ancient ruins, and rare materials.

Survival depends on awareness and strategy. Observe, adapt, and use physics-based interactions to overcome natural hazards and alien life. Smaller creatures can be confronted, but massive predators must be avoided through stealth and teamwork.

LootRun blends exploration, stealth, light horror, and discovery. Plan your route, uncover planetary secrets, gather essential resources, and return safely to the portal before the world consumes you.

Key Features

  • Solo play or online co-op for 2–4 players

  • First-person survival and exploration across alien and fantasy-inspired worlds

  • Earth base with mission tools, partial or unknown portal data

  • Session-based expeditions in large, dynamic environments

  • Stealth and survival with light horror elements

  • Physics-driven interactions and environmental challenges

  • Combat against small creatures; evasion of larger life-forms

  • Ancient alien ruins and evolving planetary mysteries

  • Resource collection and extraction to sustain humanity

Humanity’s fate depends on your discoveries. Step into the unknown, not every portal reveals its secrets until you enter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
